Market today: The market mood is tense, driven by persistent inflation and the Fed's likely interest rate hike, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield to 5%. This is a strong headwind for your tech/chip heavy portfolio, as higher rates hurt growth stocks.

Your holdings: SOXL (-59.15%) and SPAL (-30.36%) are in dire straits, both leveraged and decaying. SMH (-14.39%) also needs attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the Fed's decision this week and further movements in the 10-year Treasury yield. Also, monitor oil prices as they fuel inflation.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk on your leveraged and underperforming positions in this challenging macro environment.
plays: Review SOXL and SPAL stops immediately; consider cutting these leveraged positions to stem further losses.
Trim SMH (-14.39%) and QQQI (-3.62%) to reduce overall tech/chip exposure given rising rates.
Consider a small, diversified position in energy: GUSH (entry 47.87-47.82, stop 47.45) or XLE (entry 64.62-64.56, stop 64.35) have scanner long setups.
